services_data_appraisal_short: Before you buy or sell, we report your machine's true condition based on deep hands-on experience.
services_data_appraisal_intro: We inspect the machine you want to buy or sell with our extensive experience and give you all the information you need. Through our maintenance and service appraisal process, we help make sure the right diagnosis leads to the right work on your machine. Fill out the form below to get in touch right away.
services_data_consulting_short: From buying a machine to entering the industry, we're with you on anything on your mind.
services_data_consulting_intro: From buying machines to entering the industry — and anything else on your mind — we offer consulting on it all. Enter your details below to get the process started.
services_data_maintenance_short: Professional machine maintenance across 32 checkpoints, reported with detailed photos.
services_data_maintenance_intro: We complete your machine's maintenance professionally across 32 checkpoints, and keep you informed with a report backed by detailed photos. Just fill out the form below for a maintenance quote.
services_data_repair_short: Faults, part replacements, and repairs, delivered fast by our skilled team.
services_data_repair_intro: Our skilled, well-equipped team professionally handles faults, part replacements, and repairs, delivered as fast as possible. Fill out the form for the fastest solution.
services_data_machine_trading_short: Get an appraisal, or buy and sell at fair value — come out ahead on both sides.
services_data_machine_trading_intro: For your machine, we can provide an appraisal, or buy and sell it at fair value. With the right guidance, you come out ahead whether you're buying or selling. Fill out the form to get started right away.
common_site_description: Appraisal, consulting, maintenance, service, and machine trading for your CNC machines. Every machine works — we make it work.

home_hero_body: Appraisal, maintenance, repair and trading of your CNC machines, all under one roof. We diagnose the fault accurately, apply the right fix, and get your machine back into production as fast as possible.
home_services_title: Five services, one point of contact
home_services_description: From appraisal to machine trading — we cover your machine's entire life cycle. Every service has its own request form. Fill it in and our team will get back to you.
home_machines_description: Inspected, sale-ready used CNC machines and other equipment. Browse the listings and get in touch for details.
home_gallery_description: Images from our completed maintenance, overhaul and service work.
home_cta_body: Fill in the form and we'll resolve your fault as fast as possible — or call us directly:
about_seo_description: Uncle CNC — International CNC Service: every machine runs. Who we are and how we work.
about_hero_title_line2: We're the ones who make it run.
about_intro: {fullName} is a service company specialized in the appraisal, maintenance, repair, consulting and trading of CNC machines. We serve domestically and internationally, brand-independent, on vertical machining centers, lathes, 5-axis machines and more.
about_principles_accuracy_detail: Every job starts with an appraisal. We measure to identify the source of a fault or need — we never swap parts on a guess.
about_principles_reporting_detail: We document every procedure with detailed photos and hand over a report showing what was done and why.
about_principles_speed_detail: A stopped machine costs money. With our spare parts network and experienced team, we get your machine back into production as fast as possible.
contact_page_seo_description: Get in touch with Uncle CNC: phone, email, address and contact form.
contact_page_description: Fill in the form for your question, or call us directly. For service requests, we recommend using the form on the relevant service page.
thanks_seo_description: Your form submission was received successfully.
thanks_body: Your form has been forwarded to our team. We'll get back to you as soon as possible. For urgent matters, you can call us directly:

gallery_page_seo_description: Photos from our completed maintenance, overhaul, service and installation work.
gallery_page_description: You can request work similar to what you see here for your own machine — the link under each photo takes you to the matching service form.
references_page_seo_description: Companies who trust us with their machines, and the sectors we work with.
references_page_description: Companies from automotive to aerospace trust us with the maintenance and service of their machines.
services_page_seo_description: Appraisal, consulting, maintenance, service and machine trading — five services for your CNC machine under one roof. Fill out the request form and our team will get back to you.
services_page_description: Choose the service that fits your needs. Each service page has a request form tailored to that job. Your request goes straight to our team.
service_detail_maintenance_mechanical_de: Axis slideways, ball screws, bearings, belt-pulley systems and table alignments are checked.
service_detail_maintenance_electrical_de: Panel connections, servo drives, encoder feedback and control unit parameters are reviewed.
service_detail_maintenance_lubrication_d: Central lubrication lines, hydraulic unit pressures and coolant system maintenance are carried out.
service_detail_maintenance_precision_det: Axis geometries, spindle runout and repeatability are measured and results are reported.
service_detail_maintenance_reporting_det: Every item is documented with detailed photos and delivered along with a list of recommendations.
service_detail_contact_body: You can also request service by phone instead of the form. Call us for urgent breakdowns:

machines_page_description: Every machine has been inspected by us. Use the form on the listing page for information or an offer. If you'd like to sell a machine, reach us through the machine trading form.
